d:
Rashtriy janta dal (RJD) ke suprimo aur bihar ke purv mukhyamantri lalu prasad yadav ki chunav se jure 'aadarsh aachar sanhita ullanghan' (Model Code of Conduct Violation) ke ek purane mamle men speshal kort men peshi huee hai.
Kort men peshi ke dauran lalu prasad yadav ke svagat aur ek jhalak pane ke lie samarthakon ki bhari bhir umar pari, jise dekhte hue adalat parisar ke bahar aur aaspas suraksha ke kare intjam kie gae the.
